core_meaning.primary_meaning: Haseeb is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Reckoner, one who accounts, keeper of accounts”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haseeb corresponds to the Arabic form حسيب (Arabic root ح س ب (ḥ-s-b); حَسِيب (Ḥasīb)). Its core sense is reckoner, one who accounts, keeper of accounts. Haseeb is Arabic حَسِيب (Ḥasīb) 'reckoner, one who accounts, keeper of accounts', from the root ح س ب (ḥ-s-b). It is also one of the names of Allah (الحسيب). The source gloss 'Gift from God' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as hasib and hassib.
